description: MCU and QEMU ROM/RAM budget envelopes used by release_check.py, check_resource_budgets.py, and run_extended_checks.py. Each entry carries a 'status' field: 'measured' when the limit comes from a recorded build, 'estimated_pending_ci_baseline' when the limit is a reasonable upper bound that has not yet been re-baselined against real measurements and should be re-confirmed before a new major release.

measurement_notes.methodology: Measured limits follow the convention rom_bytes_max = ceil(measured_rom * 1.10) and ram_bytes_max = ceil(measured_ram * 1.10), giving a 10% headroom envelope. The raw measured values are recorded alongside each measured entry for audit.
measurement_notes.regeneration: Run scripts/check_resource_budgets.py --board <board> --output-root <tmp> on a host with the Zephyr SDK and the ARM toolchain (for nucleo_h743zi). The tool prints the measured ROM and RAM per run_id; update the corresponding entry and set status to 'measured' with the current measured_sdk, measured_toolchain, and measured_at values. See CONTRIBUTING.md for details.
